reason: Refactors the media URL query-building pipeline used across resize filter, shortcodes, profile service, and ImageSharp formatter into a shared MediaCommands class with ordered output and a quality/format precedence change, so any subtle ordering or overwrite bug would silently affect image URLs across many themes/modules despite the added tests.
